'''Bunurrut''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served in the [[Peace Brigade]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Bunurrut was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian gunship]] ''[[Vigor]]'' and at some point during the conflict, Bunurrut led the ''Vigor'' and the [[YV-929 armed freighter]] ''[[Blunt Force]]'' during a scheme to pose as two [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ships, to allow them to take custody of refugees being carried aboard the ''[[Wanderhome]]''.
